name: Himalaya Sun Protect+ Ultra-Light Sunscreen
search_keywords: Himalaya Sun Protect+ Ultra Light Sunscreen SPF 50 30g
notes: INCI copied from the 30g back-of-pack image (AmazonPDP_30g-021resize.png) in the official product gallery, cross-checked with tesseract OCR. The UV filters are Octocrylene, Zinc Oxide, Titanium Dioxide, Butyl Methoxydibenzoylmethane (avobenzone) and Phenylbenzimidazole Sulfonic Acid. Contains Fragrance. The site claims '90% natural origin ingredients'. The 50g (8901138010966) and 100ml lotion (8901138010973) packs were not checked separately, so they may differ, especially the lotion. Verified 2026-11-01: an enlarged crop of the official image matched this list term for term, in the same order.

name: Himalaya Sun Protect+ Ultra-Light Sunscreen (Light Tint)
marketed_for: hypoallergenic (formulated to minimize the risk of allergies)
search_keywords: Himalaya Sun Protect+ Ultra Light Tint Sunscreen SPF 50 50g
notes: Sold as the '50g Light Tint' variant on the same official page as the untinted cream. INCI copied from the back-of-pack image AmazonPDP-02.jpg, whose barcode 8901138010980 matches the Light Tint variant. I cropped and enlarged the image to read it. The print is small on the source image, so a quick visual check is advised, but every term was legible. The tint comes from iron oxides (CI 77492, CI 77491, CI 77499), and it adds C15-19 Alkane, Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil and Avocado Oil compared with the untinted version. Unlike the untinted 30g, it has no Caramel. Contains Fragrance. Nykaa lists the same product as 'Himalaya Sun Protect+ Ultra Tinted Sunscreen SPF 50 PA++++' at Rs 349 MRP. Verified 2026-11-01: an independent enlarged crop of the official image matched this list in the same order.

name: Hydra Plump Aloe Face Serum
key_actives_claimed: Aloe Vera (13% aloe vera gel claim on carton)
search_keywords: Himalaya Hydra Plump Aloe Vera Face Serum 15ml
notes: INCI copied from the 15ml carton image in the official gallery (HimalayaSerumPDP-15ml-04.jpg), cross-checked with OCR. The carton claims '95% natural origin ingredients' and 'Free From: Parabens, Phthalates, Mineral Oils & Silicones'. It contains Niacinamide, but the brand does not market it as such. Contains Fragrance plus the fragrance allergens Benzyl Salicylate and Linalool. I picked this over the Natural Glow Rose Face Serum (Rs 549, 5% niacinamide claim) because the official Rose serum page shows no INCI in its text or its five gallery images. Verified 2026-11-01: an enlarged crop of the official carton image matched this list term for term, in the same order.

name: Nourishing Skin Cream
marketed_for: can be used as make-up base
notes: Retailer source (Tata 1mg). The official page (https://himalayawellness.in/products/nourishing-skin-cream) lists only key ingredients (Aloe Vera, Indian Kino Tree, Indian Pennywort), and its only gallery image is the front of the pack. INCI copied verbatim from the 1mg 'Key Ingredients' field, which gives the full list. Name, sizes, MRP and barcode come from the official page: 100ml 8901138835279, 50ml 8901138506377, 200ml 8901138835286. Watch-outs: Mineral Oil, parabens (methyl and propyl), BHT, Parfum, and the allergen Butylphenyl Methylpropional (lilial, banned in the EU since 2022), so the Indian formula may differ from the EU one. Check against the current pack if possible. Verified 2026-11-01: the 1mg field was re-fetched and matched in the same order, and the official variants and barcodes were re-checked.

name: Himalaya Men Pimple Clear Neem Face Wash
search_keywords: Himalaya Men Pimple Clear Neem Face Wash 100ml
notes: Retailer source (Tata 1mg). The official page (https://himalayawellness.in/products/himalaya-men-pimple-clear-neem-face-wash) lists only 'Natural Salicylic Extract, Neem', and its gallery shows only the front of the pack. INCI copied verbatim from the 1mg 'Key Ingredients' field, keeping the 'Ci' spelling as printed there. Name, sizes, MRP and barcode come from the official page. The brand markets 'Natural Salicylic Extract', but the INCI lists 'Salicylic Acid'. The main surfactant is Ammonium Lauryl Sulfate, which conflicts with any 'gentle' framing. Contains Menthol and Fragrance. The 1mg page also mentions 'White Spice Active Boost Technology' (Piper Nigrum). Verified 2026-11-01: the 1mg field was re-fetched and matched in the same order, and the official variants and barcodes were re-checked.
